name: planet_map_scene
summary: Godot 4.6.3 Node3D scene that renders the social graph as a stylized planet. Players are placed as small emissive spheres on the surface at their geographic (lat, lon); friendships are drawn as great-circle arc polylines lifted slightly off the surface to avoid z-fighting. A slow orbiting camera ties the composition together. v1 ships with hardcoded seed data (NYC, Paris, Tokyo, Sydney, SF); v2 swaps for a live fetch from the dApp social-graph endpoint. Pairs with friend_graph_harvester (Facebook SDK -> player profile cache) and dapp_server.
engine_pattern: Single-controller scene. PlanetMapController._ready orchestrates fetch -> paint -> nodes -> edges -> HUD -> camera. Geometry is built imperatively at startup: SphereMesh for the planet and per-player avatars, ImmediateMesh with PRIMITIVE_LINE_STRIP for friend arcs (lightweight; no per-edge CSGCylinder). Stable per-player hue from String.hash() so colors don't reshuffle between runs.

scene_tree.PlanetMap/Earth: MeshInstance3D — SphereMesh radius 5, stylized blue ocean

math.lat_lon_to_xyz: y = r*sin(lat); x = r*cos(lat)*cos(lon); z = r*cos(lat)*sin(lon)
math.axes: +Y north pole, +X prime meridian @ equator, +Z lon=+90 (East)
math.arc_lift: midpoint of each friendship arc bulges 6% above sphere radius via sin(t*PI) bell to defeat z-fight

seed_data_v1.rationale: 5 globally-distributed cities give immediate visual confirmation that lat/lon math is correct on first launch — one node per inhabited continent, plus a US-coast pair to show short arcs alongside long ones.

primary_http.host_binding: 127.0.0.1 only — Caddy fronts TLS in production
primary_http.auth: PUBLIC read (no bearer) — analogous to /dapp/api/products and /dapp/api/balance
primary_http.response_schema: { players: [{player_id, name, lat, lon, picture_url}], friendships: [{player_a, player_b}] }
primary_http.status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — dapp_server agent (vm_mspc_001.agents.agent_defs.dapp_server) will add it next phase. Until then, fetcher.use_http stays false and seed data is returned.

upstream_harvester.name: friend_graph_harvester
upstream_harvester.responsibility: Materializes the social_graph table by joining: Facebook friends (via facebook_sdk_bridge.get_friends), player profile cache (player_id, picture_url, declared lat/lon), and friendship edges from sui_mcp on-chain follow records.
upstream_harvester.writes_to: studio/assets/_social/graph_cache.json + global cc.db tables (TBD: social_players, social_friendships)

data_sources_v2.fallback_path: embedded seed_data_v1 above — always available so the scene renders without backend services running

runtime_requirements.no_autoload_needed: true — both helpers are plain Object subclasses, instantiated on demand

inbound_callers: Top-level navigation (TBD) — main_controller.gd will add a 'Planet' button that change_scene_to_file('res://scenes/planet_map.tscn')
routing_connections.substrate_reads: seed data inline + (phase 2) studio/assets/_social/graph_cache.json via dapp_server

guarantees: Renders without backend — seed data is embedded; offline-safe
No project.godot mutation — scene is self-contained, no new autoload required
ImmediateMesh edges = O(N) draw calls but minimal memory; safe for ~100 friends. Beyond that, switch to MultiMesh or merged ArrayMesh.
Stable per-player hue across runs via id.hash() — visual identity persists
All scripts cwd-scoped to res://src/ and res://scenes/ — no absolute paths
blockers_phase_2: dapp_server: add GET /dapp/api/social_graph route that reads studio/assets/_social/graph_cache.json
friend_graph_harvester: build it (joins facebook_sdk_bridge + sui_mcp follow records into graph_cache.json)
social_players & social_friendships tables in core/lib/db.py (cc.db schema bump)
Player profile photos: requires picture_url -> texture loader (likely HTTPRequest + ImageTexture.create_from_image)
Camera controls: orbit drag, zoom, click-to-focus on a player node — currently auto-orbit only
Real Earth texture: swap stylized blue material for an equirectangular Earth texture once we ship a fetch pipeline
usage_example:
# From main_controller or any scene:
get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/planet_map.tscn")
# Or load + instantiate inline:
var packed = load("res://scenes/planet_map.tscn")
add_child(packed.instantiate())
phase: B.1 — first 3D visualization of the player social graph. Pairs with dapp_server (data source) + friend_graph_harvester (data producer) + facebook_sdk_bridge (upstream friend list).
